support.title: Create a support bundle
support.intro: A support bundle holds what someone helping you needs to find a problem. Passwords, keys and tokens never go into it; user names, folder names, addresses and host names do. Nothing leaves the box until you share the file yourself.

system.label: System
system.hint: Version, operating system, hardware, installed packages and failed services.

storage.label: Storage
storage.hint: Pools, datasets, snapshots, disks and their health data.

network.label: Network
network.hint: Addresses, routes, firewall rules and name servers.

configuration.label: Settings
configuration.hint: The box's settings, users, groups, shared folders and apps, and the configuration files it writes, without secrets.

logs.label: Logs
logs.hint: The Log Center's entries of the last 7 days and the kernel's messages since the last start.

apps.label: App containers
apps.hint: Which containers of the apps exist and their state.

memoryDump.label: Memory dump of the server
memoryDump.hint: Only when a developer asks for it. Large, and it holds secrets.

support.dumpWarning: A memory dump holds everything the server had in memory at that moment, including passwords, keys and the sign-ins of other users. Share it only with someone you trust, and delete it afterwards.
support.stepUp: {twoFactor, select, true {Confirm with your password and the code from your authenticator app.} other {Confirm with your password.}}
support.failures: {count, plural, one {# item could not be read; the bundle names it in failures.json.} other {# items could not be read; the bundle names them in failures.json.}}
support.share: Download the file and send it to the person helping you yourself.

details.label: Entry details
details.none: Choose an entry to see its details.

settings.title: Log retention
settings.intro: Current logs are kept on the system disk, so they are there even without a pool. An optional archive on a pool keeps them longer.
settings.currentStatus: They take {size} now; the oldest entry is from {oldest}.
settings.maxHint: The system and all apps together, at most 4 GB. The oldest entries go first.
settings.archiveIntro: Entries are copied to the pool once a day, and before the current logs drop any. This wakes the pool's disks about once a day.
settings.archiveEnabled: Keep an archive on a pool
settings.noPool: There is no pool that can hold the archive.
settings.archiveStatus: The archive on {pool} takes {size}; last copied {copied}.
settings.archiveUnavailable: The pool {pool} cannot hold the archive now; entries wait on the system disk until it is back.
settings.archiveOnSave: The archive starts when you save.

counts.problems: {count, plural, one {# warning or error} other {# warnings and errors}}

status.entries: {count, plural, one {# entry} other {# entries}} loaded
status.kept: Kept for {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
